checkedrule.site_amr_rules.max_travel_speedMaximum travel speed a program may request. Checked against every program (cap).

outsideobligation.site_amr_rules.risk_assessmentA current risk assessment for the mobile robot system. The site has a risk assessment that covers every route, station and task these programs use, repeated whenever the layout, the fleet or the tasks change.
outsideobligation.site_amr_rules.safety_rated_functionsPersonnel detection and stopping in safety-rated control. Personnel detection, speed control near people, braking and emergency stop run in the robot's safety-rated hardware and software, at the performance levels the standards require, not in URML and not in the fleet manager.
outsideobligation.site_amr_rules.zones_marked_and_declaredOperating and restricted zones are marked on site and match the manifest. The zones the risk assessment defines are marked on the floor or otherwise identified, and the declared_areas in each robot's manifest are drawn to match them.
outsideobligation.site_amr_rules.system_validationThe installed system is verified and validated before use. The integrator verifies and validates the safety functions of the installed mobile robot system before the site runs production programs.
outsideobligation.site_amr_rules.users_trainedPeople who work near the robots are trained and informed. The site operator trains the people who work with or near the robots, keeps the information for use current, and keeps zones clear as the risk assessment requires.
declaredrule.cell_7_safety.emergency_stop_declaredThe emergency stop's safety level is declared and meets its requirement. Declared emergency_stop_safety_level: PLd, by cell_7_safety_declarations. URML checks the declaration is there and allowed, not that it is true.
declaredrule.cell_7_safety.protective_stop_declaredThe protective stop's safety level is declared and meets its requirement. Declared protective_stop_safety_level: SIL2, by cell_7_safety_declarations. URML checks the declaration is there and allowed, not that it is true.
declaredrule.cell_7_safety.speed_monitoring_declaredSafety-rated speed monitoring is declared and meets its requirement. Declared speed_monitoring_safety_level: PLe, by cell_7_safety_declarations. URML checks the declaration is there and allowed, not that it is true.
declaredrule.cell_7_safety.safety_validation_on_recordThe safety functions' validation is on record. Declared safety_validation_record: VAL-2026-017, by cell_7_safety_declarations. URML checks the declaration is there and allowed, not that it is true.
outsideobligation.cell_7_safety.urml_is_not_a_safety_functionNothing in URML counts toward a performance level or a SIL. The URML validator and runtimes are not safety-related parts of the control system. They are left out of every performance level and safety integrity level calculation, and no safety function depends on them.
outsideobligation.cell_7_safety.urml_cannot_interfereURML cannot interfere with safety-related software. If URML runs on hardware that also runs safety-related software, the integrator shows that URML cannot interfere with it, or treats URML as safety-related, which URML does not support. The simpler design keeps URML on separate hardware.
outsideobligation.cell_7_safety.safety_functions_designedEach safety function is designed to its required level. Each safety function the risk assessment calls for is specified, designed and implemented in safety-related control to reach its required performance level or safety integrity level.
outsideobligation.cell_7_safety.safety_functions_validatedEach safety function is validated. The safety functions are validated before use, and again after any change to the safety-related control, and the validation record is kept.
outsideobligation.cell_7_safety.declarations_kept_trueThe declarations match the validation records. The operator keeps the deployment rulebook's declarations in line with the current validation records, and updates them when the safety functions or their validation change.
